scope: Lyrie V2 responsive editorial interface: centered desktop frame, initial preview alignment, mobile control wrapping, and the approved yellow-to-canvas background.

checks.state: Initial empty editor and PDF preview
checks.observed: Compared with the inspected target at its exact dimensions. The usable frame is centered and 1280 px wide; panels follow the 40:60 layout, the toolbar stays on one row, and the empty-state group centers inside the preview canvas. White introduction text on the requested yellow has measured contrast of 1.34:1 and is a documented user-directed exception.

checks.state: Initial empty editor and PDF preview at wide viewport
checks.observed: The usable frame remains 1280 px and centered; editor/preview proportions remain 40:60; preview controls use one row; the empty state is centered in both axes.

checks.state: Initial empty editor and PDF preview at ultrawide viewport
checks.observed: The usable frame remains 1280 px and centered rather than expanding or shifting with viewport width; panels and preview controls remain aligned without horizontal overflow.

checks.state: Initial editor and empty preview on mobile
checks.observed: Toolbar groups wrap by intrinsic width with no overlapping controls; the empty state stays centered inside the canvas, and the editor flows above preview.

checks.state: Initial editor at narrow mobile width
checks.observed: Document scroll width equals viewport width; the initial interface introduces no horizontal overflow.

notes: The white-on-yellow contrast is 1.34:1. The user requested the white introduction on #F4E11B; this fails WCAG text contrast thresholds and is not claimed as passing.
No deployment was performed; the separate deployed-browser release gate remains open.
